task: Land the locally-held portal Valkey TLS-only + ACL hardening that never reached origin/main

events.summary: Rescue 3 unpushed commits onto origin/main: Valkey TLS-only listener, dedicated ACL user, dedicated Secret, ingress scope; no live cluster change; requires portal build newer than 1.0.19 (VALKEY_USERNAME support).

Original claim: with the origin/main chart and bindings script restored in place, check-valkey-security-contract.py failed with AssertionError 'chart must disable the plaintext listener with exactly --port 0'; with the rescued files it passed. Independent review then found a defect that check could not see: the password file was written by 'openssl rand -hex 32 > file' (trailing newline) while users.acl used the newline-stripped value. Reproduced on a real Valkey 8.1.10 container over raw RESP: AUTH portal <hex>\n returned WRONGPASS, AUTH portal <hex> returned +OK.

Valkey serves TLS only with ACL user portal and default user off; bindings inject rediss:// and VALKEY_TLS=true, drop VALKEY_INSECURE_PRODUCTION, abort on secret read errors; check renumbered R247 after finding R240 collision. Review fixes: password generated newline-free (tr -d) and validated as 64 hex for generated and preserved values (re-tested against real Valkey: exact Secret bytes authenticate); Certificate duration/renewBefore set because Valkey 8.1.10 lacks tls-auto-reload-interval (CONFIG GET tls-* confirmed); R247 now parses Valkey flags and users.acl (duplicate flags, allowlist, no nopass/allcommands/+@ categories) with 30 mutations (round 2: effective argv = command + args, flag allowlist, no args/env, single valkey-server launcher, aclfile volume path pinned, single users.acl write), each asserting its rejection reason and proven accepted when the new checks are disabled in a temp copy. After two sonnet reviews, a Codex critic found two further bootstrap defects: an existing-but-incomplete Secret was treated as absent and its password regenerated, and first creation could race via apply. Fixed with a separate existence probe, abort on an incomplete Secret, and atomic kubectl create with an AlreadyExists re-read; exercised with a fake kubectl stub (not a real API server); R247 now has 34 mutations.

events.scope: Valkey TLS/ACL/secret/ingress contract with 34 negative mutations (static; live TLS and portal connectivity unverified)
events.summary: check-valkey-security-contract.py passes on the rebased tree.

events.scope: full static regression suite incl. R247

Static contract verified; live Valkey TLS handshake with the cluster CA and portal connectivity are not verified here (only a local Docker Valkey test existed on the original branch).

Rescue of the static Valkey TLS/ACL change and its guard verified, plus a locally reproduced and fixed password-newline AUTH mismatch (Docker Valkey 8.1.10); live TLS handshake with the cluster CA and portal connectivity are out of scope and unverified (stated in e6). Do not deploy with portal 1.0.19.
